controles.affirmation: La Cour supreme americaine a invalide une partie des tarifs imposes au titre de l'IEEPA, PepsiCo depose des demandes de remboursement dont le montant et le calendrier restent incertains
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026, Risks Associated with Tariffs : "During the 24 weeks ended June 13, 2026, the U.S. Supreme Court ruled that many of the tariffs previously imposed under the International Emergency Economic Powers Act (IEEPA) were invalid. Following this ruling, we have submitted, and expect to continue to submit, tariff recovery claims through the U.S. Customs and Border Protection (CBP) seeking a refund of certain eligible IEEPA tariffs... the ultimate recoverability, timing and amount of any such refunds remain uncertain"

controles.affirmation: L'impot minimum mondial OCDE de 15% est entre en vigueur en 2026 et fait deja monter la charge d'impot ; le taux d'imposition publie du T2 2026 monte de 3,4 points
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026 : "In 2026, widespread implementation of the OECD model rules for a global minimum tax rate of 15% came into effect in various countries in which we do business, including European Union member states, resulting in an increase in our income tax provision" ; "The reported tax rate increased 3.4 percentage points, primarily reflecting the prior-year release of federal interest accruals and the impairment of the Rockstar brand, as well as the current-year impact of the OECD model global minimum tax"

controles.affirmation: Des juridictions taxent ou envisagent de taxer les snacks selon leur teneur en sucre, sel ou graisses saturees
controles.verbatim_source: 10-K FY2025 : "certain jurisdictions in which our snack products are sold, have either imposed, or are considering imposing, new or increased taxes on the manufacture, distribution or sale of certain of our snack products as a result of ingredients (such as sugar, sodium or saturated fat) contained in such products"

controles.affirmation: La Russie represente 6% du CA et 6% des actifs, mais 21% de la tresorerie consolidee et 38% de l'ecart de conversion accumule en perte ; part passee de 10% fin 2024 a 20% fin 2025 puis 21% en juin 2026
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026 : "Our operations in Russia accounted for 6% and 5% of our consolidated net revenue for the 12 and 24 weeks ended June 13, 2026, respectively. Russia accounted for 6% of our consolidated assets, including 21% of our consolidated cash and cash equivalents, and 38% of our accumulated currency translation adjustment loss as of June 13, 2026." 10-K FY2025 : "20% and 10% of our consolidated cash and cash equivalents... as of December 27, 2025 and December 28, 2024"

controles.affirmation: Les distributeurs retirent des references et poussent leurs marques propres, verbatim identique dans le 10-K et le 10-Q, langage constate et non conditionnel
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026 et 10-K FY2025 (Our Business Risks), texte identique : "In this changing retail landscape, retailers and buying groups are shifting traditional value propositions, removing our products or otherwise reducing shelf space allocated to our products and focusing on introducing and developing private-label brands. We have seen and expect to continue to see retailers and buying groups impact our ability to compete in these jurisdictions."

controles.affirmation: BPA dilue retraite (core) de 8,14 $ en 2025 contre 8,16 $ en 2024, soit 0% de croissance y compris a devises constantes ; BPA publie 6,00 $ contre 6,95 $

controles.affirmation: Retours aux actionnaires 2025 de 8,64 Mds $ pour 8,20 Mds $ de flux de tresorerie disponible (105%), objectif 8,9 Mds $ en 2026 ; FCF en hausse de 9% uniquement grace a des investissements coupes de 903 M$, flux operationnel en baisse de 3%
